ref_text: あんた、自分の仕事も全うできないからって、私に助けろっていうの？

llm._comment_provider: Supported: claude | openai | deepseek | gemini | ollama | custom
llm._comment_api_key: Leave empty for 'claude' (uses CLI login) or 'ollama' (no key needed)
llm._comment_base_url: Leave empty for known providers; set for custom/local endpoints, e.g. http://localhost:1234/v1

_comment_sd: Absolute path to the SD checkpoint (too large to bundle); leave empty to disable selfie generation
_comment_lora: Relative or absolute path to the character LoRA weights
